# Lenovo / Motorola Tablet Debloat List
# Targets stock-Android Lenovo Tab M-series (M8/M9/M11). Safe: every removal is
# user-level (pm uninstall -k --user 0) and skipped if the package isn't present.
#
# Discover what's actually on YOUR tablet before relying on this list:
#   adb shell pm list packages | grep -iE 'lenovo|tblenovo|zui|motorola'
# Pair with: ./provision.sh debloat --level aggressive   (adds the cross-vendor bloat)
# and, if you truly want it degoogled: --degoogle (removes the Play suite too).

# === Lenovo service framework / account / ID ===
com.lenovo.lsf.user
com.lenovo.lsf.device
com.lenovo.payplus            # Lenovo Pay / account
com.lenovo.lps.cloud.sync.row

# === Lenovo tablet apps (near-stock M-series) ===
com.tblenovo.center           # Lenovo "Tab Manager" / device assistant
com.tblenovo.soundrecorder    # Lenovo Recorder
com.tblenovo.appwidget        # Lenovo widgets

# === Lenovo / partner content & suggestions ===
com.zui.gallery               # ZUI Gallery (some SKUs; use Google Photos or Immich instead)
com.lenovo.browser            # Lenovo Browser (kiosk uses FreeKiosk's webview)
com.lenovo.weathercenter
com.lenovo.magazine           # Lock-screen "magazine"/wallpaper suggestions

# === Common preinstalled third-party bloat (uncomment any that exist on yours) ===
# com.netflix.mediaclient
# com.netflix.partner.activation
# com.facebook.system
# com.facebook.appmanager
# com.facebook.services
# com.booking
# com.microsoft.skydrive
# com.amazon.mShop.android.shopping

# === DO NOT REMOVE (kept intentionally) ===
# com.tblenovo.launcher       # Stock launcher — removing before FreeKiosk is set as
#                             # Home can leave the tablet with no launcher. Set FreeKiosk
#                             # as Home first, then remove this by hand if you want.
# com.google.android.webview  # WebView engine the FreeKiosk dashboard renders in — REQUIRED.
